description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Act as a hands-on mobile engineer responsible for a consumer iOS app across its whole life, from early concept to App Store release. Partner daily with company leadership and cross-functional colleagues to deliver refined features, guide technical direction and set a high quality bar.
 What you'll do
 - Design, build and launch native iOS features in Swift, taking each one from first idea to release.
 - Shape the app's technical structure so it holds up as more engineers join.
 - Create smooth, visually refined screens and interactions.
 - Investigate live-app defects and tune stability and speed.
 - Introduce coding conventions and review habits for the mobile group.
 - Propose improvements, run experiments and iterate quickly instead of waiting for detailed specifications.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Roughly 1 to 5 or more years building iOS apps commercially, with Swift as your main language.
 - Experience launching a mobile app from scratch using MVVM or a comparable design pattern.
 - Working knowledge of the iOS platform, app design principles and consuming REST services.
 - Comfort managing asynchronous data flows.
 - History of making meaningful contributions to a widely used product, ideally on mobile.
 - Strong sense of ownership and ease with ambiguity in a startup setting.
 - Good product judgment and a keen eye for interface detail.
 - Practical experience using AI tools and agent-based workflows in day-to-day development.
 - Living in New York City or ready to relocate there.
 Bonus points
 - Exposure to a gamified consumer app or a marketplace business.
 - Time spent at a startup or design-focused company known for polished mobile products.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 130,000 to 230,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - New York City, NY, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
